mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_import_job (id, job_code, template_id, template_version, template_name, field_mapping_snapshot, source_file_id, error_file_id, requester_id, organization_id, status, version_no, failure_code, failure_message, total_rows, processed_rows, valid_rows, invalid_rows, queued_at, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{job.id}, #{job.jobCode}, #{job.templateId}, #{job.templateVersion}, #{job.templateName}, #{job.fieldMappingSnapshot}, #{job.sourceFileId}, #{job.errorFileId}, #{job.requesterId}, #{job.organizationId}, #{job.status}, #{job.versionNo}, #{job.failureCode}, #{job.failureMessage}, #{job.totalRows}, #{job.processedRows}, #{job.validRows}, #{job.invalidRows}, #{job.queuedAt}, #{job.startedAt}, #{job.completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_code, template_id, template_version, template_name, field_mapping_snapshot, source_file_id, error_file_id, requester_id, organization_id, status, version_no, failure_code, failure_message, total_rows, processed_rows, valid_rows, invalid_rows, queued_at, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_import_job WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, job_code, template_id, template_version, template_name, field_mapping_snapshot, source_file_id, error_file_id, requester_id, organization_id, status, version_no, failure_code, failure_message, total_rows, processed_rows, valid_rows, invalid_rows, queued_at, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_import_job WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY queued_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, job_code, template_id, template_version, template_name, field_mapping_snapshot, source_file_id, error_file_id, requester_id, organization_id, status, version_no, failure_code, failure_message, total_rows, processed_rows, valid_rows, invalid_rows, queued_at, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_import_job
ORDER BY queued_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_import_job SET status = 'VALIDATING', version_no = version_no + 1, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE sys_import_job SET status = #{status}, error_file_id = #{errorFileId}, total_rows = #{totalRows}, processed_rows = #{processedRows}, valid_rows = #{validRows}, invalid_rows = #{invalidRows}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'VALIDATING' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE sys_import_job SET status = 'SYSTEM_FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'VALIDATING' AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}
